create_quantization_recipe: create an FP8 quantization recipe using QuantizationModifier with per-channel weights and dynamic per-token activations
run_oneshot_quantization: run oneshot quantization on a Qwen2.5-VL model with a FP8_DYNAMIC quantization recipe
dispatch_model_for_offload: dispatch a quantized model for CPU offload using compressed_tensors dispatch_model
generate_text_with_quantized_model: generate text from a quantized Qwen2.5-VL model using processor and model.generate
save_quantized_model_compressed: save a quantized model and processor to disk in compressed-tensors format
